previous.claim: Analyzing dependency graphs to redesign execution. (a) Critical-path analysis identifies the longest weighted dependency chain, which sets a latency floor of 12 seconds in this illustrative graph. Two possible responses are shown. (b) Decomposing the dominant operation into independent suboperations reduces the modeled critical path to 7 seconds, excluding coordination overhead. (c) Changing the information dependencies can remove a serial constraint altogether. In DocAble’s image-description pipeline, replacing propagation of previously generated descriptions with shared rendered context allowed the image-description operations to proceed independently.
